concerns.text: Optimizer SR_ann = arithmetic Sharpe (mean*12 / sd*sqrt(12)) = 2.6427. PerformanceAnalytics geometric SR = 2.8599 (ΔSR +0.2172). Convention-aligned reproduce: 28/28 metrics exact match. Per Backtest Contract v1.0 PerformanceAnalytics standard, Optimizer should TAG 'mean_ann_arithmetic' and 'SR_arithmetic' explicitly, OR migrate sleeve composite to geometric SR for consistency with STR_1715/Hybrid PG2. Reference L-282 (manual vs PerfA convention drift +0.19 SR points)

Optimizer Sortino = mean_ann / (sqrt(mean(neg^2))*sqrt(12)) uses neg-only second moment (sample size = n_neg, NOT full n). PerformanceAnalytics::SortinoRatio uses full n in denominator. This yields Optimizer Sortino 3.39 vs PerfA Sortino_ann 6.90 (~2x). Both conventions are documented in literature (Sortino-Price 1994 vs Plantinga 2007). Recommendation: select ONE Sortino convention and tag explicitly.
